paper_title: Thinking Slow, Fast Scaling Inference Compute with Distilled Reasoners
caption: : Majority voting.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and majority voting accuracy. The x-axis represents the number of completions, labeled as "Number of completions (k)", with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2^0 to 2^8, and tick labels at regular intervals of 1 on the logarithmic scale, showing values from 1 to 256. The y-axis represents the majority voting accuracy, labeled as "Majority voting accuracy", with a linear scale, ranging from 0.3 to 0.6. The plot displays three lines: one blue line with circular markers and a solid style, one green line with triangular markers and a solid style, and one light blue line with triangular markers and a dashed style. The blue line starts at approximately 0.45 and increases to 0.62; the green line starts at approximately 0.45 and increases to 0.61; the light blue line starts at approximately 0.33 and increases to 0.44.
